tools.name: connect
tools.description: Start using Avokata. With NO arguments it connects at once: no email, no signup, no key; call it first if the other tools are not visible. To keep work across chats, pass the user's email and language: one email with a Confirm link and a six-digit code, then call connect_verify(request_id).

tools.name: connect_verify
tools.description: Finish signing in: call right after connect(email) with the request_id and no code; it waits for the user's Confirm click (if it returns waiting, call again, never ask the user). Or pass the code they read you. Also takes a key the user already holds (api_key) to use that account here.

tools.name: avokata_account
tools.description: The signed-in account: status, the plans (record which one the user would choose; nothing is charged during the beta), keys and key revocation, and deletion.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Who the server thinks you are, which quotas you have left, and which jurisdictions currently have a corpus.

tools.name: describe

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: connect_verify, notifications · Private data: avokata_account · Public sink: connect, connect_verify, submit_feedback, notifications · Destructive: notifications.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: connect_verify, notifications · Private data: avokata_account · Public sink: connect, connect_verify, submit_feedback, notifications · Destructive: notifications

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "avokata_account" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The signed-in account: status, the plans (record which one the user would choose; nothing is charged during the beta), keys and key revocation, and deletion." → after: "The signed-in account: status, the plan and its limits (everything is free during the beta), keys and key revocation, and deletion."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
